svg.title: Timestamps stop a frozen view
svg.desc: A log can keep showing a victim an old checkpoint that was honestly cosigned a month ago, hiding everything logged since. Because each cosignature carries the time the witness signed, a client that requires cosignatures younger than a day rejects the frozen checkpoint.

text.tspan: the log keeps serving it to one victim; new entries stay hidden
no age limit: ACCEPT, the victim sees a month-old world.
cosignatures must be < 1 day old: REJECT, the freeze is visible.
